subject: Marketplace co-sell demo — timeblock brokerage and runbook prep
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina@nebula-systems.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell — proposed demo windows

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — Nebula is excited to move to a joint marketplace demo with Redwood + CloudBridge (our SI). We want to lock a 60-minute slot to cover: short intros, architecture/permissions for the marketplace listing, a live demo of inference on our sample workload, and a quick Q&A about routing/fallbacks across regions.

Proposed windows (all times in GMT+1):
- Tue Sep 8, 14:00–15:00
- Wed Sep 9, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Sep 10, 16:00–17:00

Attaching a draft agenda (agenda-v1.pdf). Two asks up front:
1) Can Redwood bring someone who can speak to Dedicated vs Hosted fallback behavior for multi-region demos?
2) CloudBridge will need confirmation on any firewall/VPC peering notes for a short pre-demo run.

Tom from CloudBridge is cc'd — Tom, can you confirm presenter availability for the suggested windows?

Thanks,
Nina

--
Nina Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, Nebula Systems
+nina@nebula-systems.com
Attachments: agenda-v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Marketplace co-sell — proposed demo windows

Forwarding Nina's options — quick notes from my side:
- I can cover Hosted vs Dedicated fallback and the smart routing behavior if I own the demo runtime portion.
- Karthik: can you handle Marketplace listing / procurement questions (docs/hubspot flow)?
- Vanessa/Sojo: we should decide whether to run the live inference in eu-central or eu-west; Nebula prefers eu-central, CloudBridge wants eu-west for low-latency to their staging.

Constraints:
- Production-like run requires a dedicated test pool for the run (I can request a 2-hour reserved slot from Dedicated). That requires 48h notice.
- If firewall/VPC peering is required, we should run a 30-min dry run one business day before.

My availability for Nina's slots (GMT+1):
- Sep 8 14:00 — OK (prefer)
- Sep 9 10:00 — conflict (customer call)
- Sep 10 16:00 — maybe (needs swap)

Propose we aim for Sep 8 14:00 GMT+1 and schedule a 30-min dry run on Sep 7 14:00 GMT+1.

Thoughts?

-Jasmine

Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Nina Patel <nina@nebula-systems.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell — proposed demo windows

Thanks Jasmine — Sep 8 14:00 GMT+1 works for me too, but small ask: CloudBridge has a roadmap presentation with an APAC team and wants the demo time pushed 30 minutes later if possible to avoid overlap.

Can we make it 14:30–15:30 GMT+1 instead? That gives CloudBridge time to wrap. If Nebula cannot do 14:30, our fallback is Sep 10 16:00 (but that pushes the dry run).

Tom / Nina: is 14:30 an option? If yes, I'll generate the final calendar invite and attach a short runbook draft (runbook-dryrun.pdf).

Quick operational items for the runbook (I'll add in the doc):
- Join URL + host accounts (Redwood / Nebula / CloudBridge)
- Network checklist (egress IPs, ports 443 + 9000 if KV cache remote ops)
- Test corpus and expected throughput targets
- Fallback play: if Dedicated pool not available, run on Hosted with autoscale + token limit

-Vanessa

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook-dryrun.pdf (pdf, 220KB)
From: Tom Alvarez <tom@cloudbridge.io>
To: Nina Patel <nina@nebula-systems.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell — proposed demo windows

All: 14:30–15:30 GMT+1 on Tue Sep 8 works for our presenters.

Nina: confirmed with the SI team — we'll join the dry run on Sep 7 14:00 as proposed and will review the runbook (thanks Vanessa). I'll add two bullet points for networking: CloudBridge will provide a short firewall whitelist (IP list) and a brief doc on their staging endpoint.

Next steps:
- Vanessa: please send calendar invite + Zoom link (hosted by Redwood).
- Jasmine: request the Dedicated test pool for Sep 8 13:30–15:30 GMT+1 (to allow setup time).
- Karthik: can you pull together the quick procurement checklist for the Marketplace listing and drop in the Drive folder linked below?

I'll also upload a short presenter slide pack to the Drive link.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Tom
Lead Systems Architect, CloudBridge
Tom Alvarez <tom@cloudbridge.io>
